DMSchema.description: Custom attributes to indicate core DM concepts, may include struct classes intended for use in core custom attributes.

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Identifies a schema as dynamically generated by an application. Like versions of a schema may differ and are not guaranteed to merge without conflicts.
Identifies a schema file/object that may only contain part of the complete schema. Like versions of a schema may differ but are guaranteed to merge without conflicts.

DMStructClass.description: Used to define a supplemental schema and its purpose

DMProperty.description: Full name of the supplemental schema

DMStructClass.description: Reference to a schema including name and version

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Identifies a schema as a supplemental schema and stores extra metadata necessary for supplemental schemas

DMStructProperty.description: References the primary schema this supplemental should be applied to

DMProperty.description: Positive integer defining the precedence of this supplemental schema. Higher precedences override lower precences. The primary schema is considered to have a precedence between 199 and 200.
A string representing the function of this supplemental schema. Standard name formatting for a supplemental schema is <PrimarySchemaName>_Supplemental_<Purpose>

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Optional additional meta data for DMProperties of type DateTime.

DMProperty.description: Either Utc, Local or Unspecified. Default: Unspecified. When specifying a DateTimeKind, it is usually not necessary to specify a DateTimeComponent because a DateTimeKind implies the DateTimeComponent 'DateTime'.
Either DateTime or Date. Default: DateTime. Specifying 'Date' usually implies that a DateTimeKind is irrelevant, because dates (without time) don't need any timezone information.

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Applied to a property to indicate that custom attributes using this property can be localized.
Applied to abstract DMEntityClasses which serve as secondary base classes for normal DMEntityClasses.

DMProperty.description: This mixin may only be applied to entity classes which derive from this class. Class Name should be fully specified as 'alias:ClassName'

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Makes a class 'sealed' outside of the schema containing the class

DMArrayProperty.description: Optionally allows specific classes in other schemas to subclass this class. Use format '[SchemaName]:[ClassName]', e.g. 'Fruit:Banana'

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Identifies a property which is designed to be hidden from the user interface

DMProperty.description: If set to true show the hidden property. Defaults to False. Allows a property override to show a hidden property in a derived class

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Identifies a schema which is designed to be hidden from the user interface. By default all classes in the schema are hidden as well.

DMProperty.description: If true classe in the schema will be shown. Default is False. If set to true individual classes may be hidden using the HiddenClass custom attribute

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Identifies a class which is designed to be hidden from teh user interface. Hides the class it is applied to and all derived classes

DMProperty.description: If set to true show the hidden class. Defaults to False. Allows a derived class to be shown even though it's base class is hidden

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Identifies a schema or item within a schema as deprecated. Deprecated things should not be used.

DMProperty.description: Gives advice about avoiding the deprecated item or other helpful information related to the deprecation of the item.

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Used to indicate that the property this custom attribute is applied to is an extension property.
